title: Where's Kinger? (Digital Circus)
blurb: Somebody has wandered off again. Kinger, the enormous chess piece with the frayed nerves, has been inside the digital circus longer than any other resident, and the show plays his unravelling as sad rather than comic, which is why the fandom took to him so quickly. Asking after him is practically routine. Twelve seconds long, so trim to taste. Most people fire it into a voice channel the second a group goes quiet, though it serves equally well as a way of noting that the one person you actually needed has disappeared.
origin: A line about Kinger from The Amazing Digital Circus (Glitch Productions).
